acceptedAnswer.text: Medical ozone therapy delivers a controlled dose of ozone to gently stimulate your antioxidant and immune responses. It is used to support immune balance and oxidative load. Here it is ordered off your labs, given through the appropriate route, and supervised by a physician.

Given under physician supervision by trained clinicians, through appropriate routes and doses after screening, medical ozone is generally well tolerated. Screening matters, which is why care here starts with a consult and labs rather than a walk-in booking.

mainEntity.name: What is ozone therapy used for?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is commonly used as support for immune balance, inflammatory and oxidative load, and certain infections, as part of a broader plan. It is chosen for a specific reason your testing supports, not as a routine add-on.

mainEntity.name: How many ozone sessions do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what your labs show and what we are addressing. Some patients benefit from a short series, others from occasional sessions. Inside the membership plan you use it as your plan calls for, instead of paying per session.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a wellness lounge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Here ozone is ordered off your lab results and supervised by a physician as one tool inside a complete functional medicine plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I just book ozone without becoming a patient?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ozone here is always part of physician-led care. You start with a $99 Symptom Consultation so it can be ordered and supervised safely and actually fit your needs.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: Ozone therapy in Atlanta, physician-supervised to calm inflammation and lift your energy.

paragraphs: If you have read about ozone for inflammation, infection, or stubborn immune issues, the interest is understandable. The risk is doing a powerful therapy somewhere that treats it as a novelty with no workup.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD. Here ozone is ordered off your labs and given under physician supervision, as one move inside a plan treating the reason behind your symptoms. That is how it becomes real, lasting support.

sections.label: What it is

headings.text: A controlled oxidative nudge, delivered under medical supervision.

paragraphs: Medical ozone delivers a controlled dose of ozone to gently stimulate your body’s oxidative and immune responses. The mechanism is real and the therapy is powerful, and it delivers when it is ordered off your labs and run inside a plan that treats the cause.
A measured ozone dose nudges your antioxidant and immune systems, used carefully and precisely.
It is commonly used to support immune balance and oxidative load as part of a wider plan.
We use it for a specific reason your testing supports, so each session has a clear purpose.

sections.label: Who it's for

headings.text: Ozone therapy is right for some people. It is wrong for others.

eyebrowSpans: It is not for you if
paragraphs: If that second list stung a little, good. That honesty is exactly what you are paying for here.

boldPairs.body: You are dealing with inflammatory, immune, or oxidative issues your workup supports
You want advanced support inside a supervised, root-cause plan
You want it ordered for a clear reason and given by clinicians inside a plan

boldPairs.title: It is not for you if

boldPairs.body: You want a trendy one-off with no interest in why you have symptoms
You are hoping a single therapy replaces a real workup or plan
You expect it to fix a root cause it was never going to touch alone

sections.label: Not a biohack

headings.text: Ozone is having a moment online. That is exactly the problem.

paragraphs: Booked off a menu with no workup, ozone is just a novelty you hope helps. No labs, no supervision plan, no one asking why you needed it. Here, ozone is ordered off your results and given under physician supervision, as one tool inside a plan treating the actual cause.

boldPairs.title: Ordered off labs, not a menu
boldPairs.body: We use ozone for a specific, testable reason, so you are treating something real.

boldPairs.title: One tool in a plan, not the answer
boldPairs.body: The session supports the work; the plan around it is what actually moves your health.

boldPairs.title: A physician supervising, not an upsell
boldPairs.body: Screened, ordered, and supervised by a doctor who knows your whole history.
